name: Circuit breaker with electronic trip unit
summary: A breaker electronic trip unit measures current and applies configured protection functions.
description: A breaker electronic trip unit measures current and applies configured protection functions. A functional tag should link the breaker to its selected trip unit, sensors and settings record.
readingNotes: Protection setting letters and function names depend on the trip unit family.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: The electronic trip unit is part of breaker protection; a remote protection relay is a separate device unless the design documents otherwise.
